req.title: PUT rejects payload ID mismatch
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 400 when the playerId in the path does not match the id in the PUT body.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that PUT /players/squadnumber/{squad_number} must return HTTP 400 when the squad_number in the path does not match the squad_number in the request body. The route handler checks `if player_model.squad_number != squad_number` and raises HTTPException(400). Tests must cover: (1) positive — matching IDs yield non-400 response; (2) negative — mismatched IDs yield exactly 400; (3) boundary — squad_number differing by exactly ±1 from path value. Additional tests cover the decision table (both sides of the equality check) and state transition (mismatch before any DB lookup). Mutation targets: the != operator (could be mutated to ==), the 400 status constant (could be mutated to 404/422), and the comparison operands.

tests.name: test_put_matching_squad_number_returns_non_400
preconditions: Player with squad_number=10 exists in the database (Lionel Messi)
actions: Send PUT /players/squadnumber/10 with body containing squad_number=10 (matching path)
expected: Response status code is NOT 400 (mismatch guard does not trigger)
Response status code is 204 or 500 (route proceeds past the mismatch check)
trace: R-PLAYER-011: when path and body squad_number match, the 400 guard must NOT fire
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_put_matching_squad_number_returns_non_400():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Lionel",
        "middleName": "Andrés",
        "lastName": "Messi",
        "dateOfBirth": "1987-06-24T00:00:00.000Z",
        "squadNumber": 10,
        "position": "Right Winger",
        "abbrPosition": "RW",
        "team": "Paris Saint-Germain",
        "league": "Ligue 1",
        "starting11": True
    }
    r = client.put("/players/squadnumber/10", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code != 400
    assert r.status_code in (204, 500)

test_put_matching_squad_number_returns_non_400()

actions: Send PUT /players/squadnumber/999 with body containing squad_number=888 (both path and body are non-existent, but they mismatch)
expected: Confirms mismatch guard fires before the DB existence check
